# Branch secretariat (xingsheng) of the inner provinces: a building-type subject of the Yuan. Copied from the theme type
# oe_empire_theme (OEBYZ in_game/common/subject_types/oe_empire_theme.txt) by way of the Y2 prototype's oe_yx_xingsheng and
# trimmed: no overlord or military bonuses, joins no wars, declares none, no tribute (subject_oe_gov_tax is 0), never joins
# independence wars. Land stays with CHI. The map fields only matter for land subjects; kept so the type follows the overlord.
oe_yp_xingsheng = {
	subject_pays = subject_oe_gov_tax
	color = subject_samanta
	level = 2
	type = building
	government = monarchy

	join_offensive_wars_always = {
		always = no
	}
	join_offensive_wars_can_call = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_yp_xingsheng_call_tt
			scope:actor ?= { NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:recipient } }
			scope:recipient ?= {
				OR = {
					var:oe_yp_tier ?= 3
					has_variable = oe_yp_cd_shumiyuan
				}
			}
		}
	}
	join_defensive_wars_always = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_yp_xingsheng_defend_tt
			OR = {
				scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
				scope:recipient ?= {
					OR = {
						var:oe_yp_tier ?= 3
						var:oe_yp_tier ?= 2
						has_variable = oe_yp_cd_shumiyuan
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	can_be_annexed = no
	subject_can_cancel = no
	overlord_can_cancel = no

	diplomatic_capacity_cost_scale = 0.0
	can_change_rank = no
	can_change_heir_selection = no
	has_overlords_ruler = no

	has_limited_diplomacy = yes
	fleet_basing_rights = yes
	food_access = yes
	use_overlord_map_color = yes
	use_overlord_map_name = yes

	great_power_score_transfer = 0.25

	institution_spread_to_overlord = monthly_institution_spread_severe
	institution_spread_to_subject = monthly_institution_spread_severe

	strength_vs_overlord = -0.25

	overlord_modifier = {
	}

	subject_modifier = {
		loyalty_to_overlord = 5
	}
	creation_visible = {
		always = no
	}

	visible_through_diplomacy = {
		always = no
	}

	visible_through_treaty = {
		always = no
	}

	enabled_through_diplomacy = {
		always = no
	}
	on_enable = {}

	on_disable = {}

	will_join_independence_wars = no
	allow_declaring_wars = { always = no }
}
